judge.rationale: The candidate completely omitted the actual production code fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`—moving `beforeSession` inside the `try` block—meaning the newly added acceptance test will immediately fail. Additionally, the candidate failed to update `CHANGELOG.md` as explicitly required by the acceptance criteria. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate left the new behavior bullet under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section rather than moving it to the main specification section as the reference did. It also placed the test in a new standalone file and left behind a `.lore/dod.md` scratchpad file instead of adding the test to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
